name: The Corrupter
summary: Near Maurin Bonesplitter, the demon lord has proved more dangerous than he expected. Maurin believes Takata Steelblade doubts his skill, and that withholding what happened would dishonor Takata. So he sends you to speak with the swordsman nearby.

sections.title: A Matter of Honor
sections.body:
The demon lord has proved more dangerous than Maurin Bonesplitter expected. Maurin believes Takata Steelblade doubts he can handle the creature, and keeping Takata uninformed would insult the swordsman's honor.

Maurin asks you to speak with Takata and offer to slay the demon, if Takata allows it. He cautions you not to press too hard, for he thinks Takata should believe the idea is his own.

sections.title: Across the Path
sections.body: Takata Steelblade is nearby, across the path from Maurin. He stands on a cliff overlooking the Kodo Graveyard.

sections.title: Takata's Answer
sections.body:
Takata Steelblade witnessed what passed between Maurin and the demon lord. Though the creature was only an apparition, it seemed more powerful than Maurin, his warlock companion. Takata wonders whether Maurin can defeat it.

Takata could better serve the Warchief by facing the demon himself. Yet his duties here keep him from leaving to fight for personal honor without disgracing his clan.

faq.q: Why does Maurin Bonesplitter want Takata Steelblade told?
faq.answer: The demon lord has proved far more dangerous than Maurin Bonesplitter expected. Maurin believes Takata Steelblade doubts his abilities, and keeping the swordsman uninformed would insult Takata's honor.
Takata Steelblade is nearby, across the path from Maurin, on a cliff overlooking the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Maurin advise against pressing Takata too hard?
faq.answer: Maurin asks you to offer to slay the demon if Takata allows it, without pressing too hard. He thinks Takata should believe the idea is his own.
